notes: Located from the warehouse podium found while registering lothal:bisht2015-fig10.10a (square outline with a grid of blocks in its north-west part, about 120 m south-west of the dock). Release 16749 (in Wayback releases from 2021-10-13 to 2022-08-31; capture date not reported by the tools) shows the block passages most clearly; the current mosaic (2026-02-27) shows the same lines with less contrast. The plan's block group is longer along its y axis while the imagery's is longer along x, so the plan is turned about a quarter turn against the image; which way was decided by the drawn edge line at the plan's left, which matches the podium edge adjacent to the long side of the block group, and by the plan's closing line at the bottom, which falls on the podium's other edge. The plan's compass rose (render px about 800, 590) came into view while I looked at the top-left corner; I did not use it.
